what: Baseline and positive control for the zero-tolerance gate on live code entities holding no :introduced-by (evals/at_scale/introduced_by_audit.py, entities_without_introduced_by). Read off fact_audit's existing whole-graph [:find ?e ?a ?v] scan.

baseline.note: The denominator is the positive control and is why the zero is believable: a check that matched no code entities would also report 0 entities. It ships in the result rather than living only here, so every future run re-proves it.

cost.note: Rides the scan fact_audit already holds in memory -- one pass over a dict, not a second query, scan or lease. The 0.09s difference is within run-to-run variation of the whole audit step.

the_other_gates_read_this_graph_clean.note: Not a caveat -- the point. On an AFFECTED graph these read clean too: the index is missing exactly the fact the graph is missing, so the two witnesses agree perfectly; introduced_by_duplicates skips anything holding fewer than two values; and #313's runs printed nothing. That is why this is a separate gate clause and not a term in divergence.

external_dependency_exclusion.measured_from: the run's fact index, read read-only while the correction sweep was still running -- the final graph was in a TemporaryDirectory and is gone
external_dependency_exclusion.caveat: A mid-run reading, so the count is not the final one. It is recorded for its RATIO, not its magnitude: every external-dependency entity in this graph lacks :introduced-by. Had the type been in CODE_ENTITY_TYPES the gate would have been red on the first run it ever gated. This repo has no git submodules, so only the unresolved-import-stub branch is exercised here; the submodule branch does write an :introduced-by.
corroborated_by: mcp_server.py, _forward_apply's dep-edge branch: a stub is opened with exactly :entity-type, :ident and :description
mcp_server.py, _build_close_triples' docstring: 'unresolved-import stubs reuse the module ident prefix but never have an :introduced-by fact'
_reverse_apply's candidate_idents comes from _build_code_triples, which never yields a dep stub, so the lineage machinery cannot give one
tests/test_at_scale_introduced_by_audit.py: adding the type to CODE_ENTITY_TYPES fails 3 tests (ablation-proven)

entity_type_histogram_mid_run.note: Same mid-run index reading as above, and lower than the final graph for the same reason: the correction sweep closes entities as it goes.
